title: Chapter 547
paragraphs: Chapter 547
Episode 145: Premonition (16)
Excluding Ron, Jin had the longest range among the warriors in the Sword Emperor's camp.

His light-speed pierce, enveloped in lightning energy, did not lose its strength even within the flames of the 2nd version. The fiercely advancing sword Qi was slaughtering the runes and lines hidden deep within the 2nd version's flames.
If it were the past.

If it were before Jin ascended to the ranks of the 'Great Warriors' recognized by all, he would have been subjected to much skepticism and verification before undertaking this task, and so might have missed the opportunity.
But not anymore.
There was no need to explain how he knew the weaknesses of the 2nd version, or why they should follow his groundless words.
All they had to do was act according to his will. After all, Jin had never once disappointed those who believed in him.
The Bamul Alliance and the Sword Saints, who were cutting the runes and lines, confirmed each time that the 2nd version's flames were shrinking and fading.
It was a destruction born of perfect harmony.
Ron's formless Sword Wind, which can be launched while protecting all allies, Jin's magical ability and cancellation formula, and the warriors among warriors.

Without any one of these, this destruction could not have been successful. Even if one knew the cancellation formula, there weren't many people in the world who could scatter magic power in these terrifying flames and properly swing a sword.
'Lord Jin... has a power that brings victory. An unexplainable power.'
'How can I not serve such a Lord!'
The sight of Jin, the Bamul Alliance, and the Sword Saints blocking the 2nd version while floating in the formless Sword Wind itself exuded a mythical atmosphere.
It was filled with a sublime feeling.
The desperate and pure struggle of people to not collapse, not break, to protect what is precious, always had such a law.

That's why, even in the face of Zefil, even in the vicious flames of the 2nd version, even in the battle where life and death confront each other every second, even while swinging their swords until their arms break and straining their energy,
They felt a sense of fulfillment within.
"Urgh...!"
Kelliac swallowed the heat rising in his throat and bulged his eyes. Blood vessels stood in his pupils, and the drops of blood flowing from his nose dyed his beard red.
"Master!"
Octavia shouted.
It was hard to accept the fact that Jin Runecandel, not Syron, not Ron, had made the Master bleed for the first time in decades, even after seeing it directly.
Kelliac showed her a hand as if to say he was okay. Unlike the backlash, his hand holding the Hrotti did not tremble at all.
"It seems Hyster has revealed the cancellation formula of the 2nd version. The Hysters, persistently resilient friends...."
Despite the backlash, Kelliac was calmly retracting the magic power of the 2nd version.
He had already overcome the limit of 'magic backlash' a long time ago.

There might have been physical damage, but it's no longer the case that Kelliac Ziphil can't use magic due to backlash. It's not the power of the magic stone, it's an achievement accomplished entirely by the human, Kelliac Ziphil.
"Octavia, I'll open the path again. So that I can focus on Ron Hyran, you take care of the annoying ones."
"Understood."
Kelliac's eyes turned into a vivid blue flame. The magic of the Ziphil family, the Blue Flame Vision, that the past Mueron Ziphil used.
Naturally, its power was incomparable to Mueron's magic. At the same time, another flame formed in his left hand, and the Huroti began to emit a blue thunderbolt.

Kelliac had surpassed the realm of 'super simultaneous casting', using more than three types of magic. Including the not yet fully recollected Type 2, he was casting four major spells at the same time.
Blue Flame Vision
Crazy Thunderbolt
Destruction Flame Jewel - Kelliac Ziphil
Destruction Dark Sky Flame Jewel Demon Emperor Type 2
Among them, Type 2 was quickly recollected and was replaced by Ziphil's frost-bound vision magic, 'Frost Hell'. Each of these four spells possessed a power comparable to Type 2.
The total amount of magical power was three times that of Type 2, meaning the weight of the magical power that Ron had to endure increased accordingly.

Lightning fell crazily from the sky, the disappeared flame of Type 2 was replaced by the improved Destruction Flame Jewel of Kelliac Ziphil, a cold explosion echoed in the frozen air, and blue flames broke out wherever his gaze fell.
And the progression of the pervasive sword energy that filled the battlefield slowed down. Ron's sword energy was being obstructed by Kelliac's magic and losing its power.

The flight of the warriors riding the formless sword energy became precarious. The solid center of gravity, as if stepping on the ground, wobbled, and fire, cold, and thunder attacked them from all sides.
The power of Kelliac Ziphil was completely beyond the category of magic they knew.
It was closer to an unstoppable disaster than magic. The party had to grit their teeth and, with the feeling of stepping on a bomb, they had to find the safe formless sword energy.
Each step in the air entwined by the scattered magic left a cold sweat running down their backs.
Stepping on the frozen formless sword energy felt like cutting off an ankle, and when they tried to find a foothold again, two kinds of flame pressured their bodies.
The rushing lightning easily tore their shields, and if they swung their sword to strike it, it felt like their wrist would burst.
Until Ron reached his peak, Kelliac Ziphil was clearly a person with the power of World Rank II. The only reason the party could even have a 'feeling' of fighting him was because of Ron's existence.
Jin didn't know the dispelling method for these new spells.
Even if he knew, he couldn't dispel them in this state. In terms of pure magical achievement, Kelliac was far surpassing the realm that Jin had reached.
However, this fact did not break the fighting spirit of Jin and the party.
It just complicated their minds. They felt stifled, not knowing how to strike back at the peak of that magic.
"Right, if he just broke down after taking a hit from Jin, he couldn't be called the head of the Ziphil family. Isn't that right, Kelliac?"
Ron was standing in a completely different realm from those struggling in the sky.
That's why his heart was not troubled like theirs. All he had to do was face a head-on confrontation of power. Ron was watching Octavia's ship heading towards Sword Emperor Star.
Just as Kellic entrusted Octavia to deal with the Barmel Alliance and Sword Emperor, now Ron had to entrust them with Octavia as well.
The battle began, with each focusing on their suitable opponents.
Kellic, the fleet, the dragon, and Ron.
Octavia, the Phantom Squad, the Barmel Alliance, and Sword Emperor.

The battlefield was quickly divided at a rapid pace. As Octavia approached, Ron gradually reduced the intangible sword wind protecting his allies, and Kellic also reduced the magical assistance for Octavia's infiltration as the Barmel Alliance and Sword Emperor moved further away.
It took less than three minutes for Kellic and Ron to focus all their power on each other.
By then, Jin's group and Octavia's ship had found a place on the plain in front of Sword Emperor Star, avoiding the fierce battle between the two giants in the sky.
Those who had not reached the peak could hardly breathe in the overwhelming storm of the battlefield.
Creak-!
Octavia's ship crashed to the ground. It had already been damaged, unable to function properly, having been swept by sword qi and magic.

Even that was the result of Octavia and the Phantom Squad desperately extending their protective shields. Their flight distance was much longer than Jin's group, which meant they had to endure the power of the two superhumans more.
"Jin Lun Kandel...."
A dark and low voice; Octavia's eyes, staring at Jin, were filled with intense murderous intent.
The murderous intent vibrated from under the hood of the Phantom Squad members. They all remembered losing a comrade because of Jin.
"Octavia Zipel."
"I never thought that sparing your life on Veradin's island would come back to haunt me like this."
Octavia recalled the conversation she had with Murakan that day.
-Do you think Lun Kandel can defeat us and ascend the throne of the world? It seems you've forgotten the lesson left by your old contractor a thousand years ago.

-[Hahaha! Who said the king of the world would be from the Lun Kandel family? I'm talking about my current contractor right now. You don't even realize that today is your last chance to change the future, and you keep babbling.]
Even then.
Octavia couldn't help but sneer at the absurd story that Jin Lun Kandel, not Lun Kandel, would become the loser of the world.
So she remembered the extremely unpleasant memory, and that filthy intuition was still wrinkling Octavia's forehead.
She had never felt a more ominous feeling in her life.
'Why?'
And how on earth?
Not being able to kill Jin at Veradin's villa was an event from early 1798. It's now April 1800, so only two years have passed since then.
But in those two years, Jin had become incredibly strong, virtually a heavyweight, and was now directly confronting her in the war. In just two years...

"Firstly, I must sincerely express my respect. Jin Lun Kandel, you are an astonishingly desirable and shockingly amazing human being. Incomprehensibly long-lived... You even managed to survive an encounter with me."
Jin didn't respond.
Objectively, the Barmel Alliance and the Sword Saints were clearly weaker than Octavia and the Phantom Corps.
The 30 Phantom Corps led directly by the second-in-command of Ziepil were at a level where they could only be countered by the combined forces of Lun Kandel's first army, including the Black Knights.
If the Sword Saints hadn't deployed the Sword of the Overlord, the chances of winning wouldn't have existed at all.
'Even if the Sword of the Overlord is deployed, the odds are not high. But if I fall back... the family can't just sit back and watch.'
As Jin thought, Rosa was reading the flow of the battle and inferred Jin's situation.

'With the youngest's capabilities, it's impossible to handle Octavia and the Phantom Corps. Should the head of the family join the battle? If she doesn't step forward, I'll have to send the Black Knights.'
Even if there were issues with Ziepil in future negotiations, even if they entered a full-scale war, they couldn't afford to lose Jin now. Rosa had made that judgement.
However, Jin envisioned a plan where he drew out the potential of the Sword of the Overlord, a variable he possessed, to the limit to fend off Octavia.
The odds were low, but not zero. Because he had won countless times with such low odds before.
'If my mother intervenes, Dante's chances of survival will completely disappear. The family is only here to destroy or acquire the White Stone, not considering his life at all.'
Above all, that was what mattered.
His friend Dante might already be in a 'point of no return'. But Jin had no intention of letting go of his hope for him. It wouldn't change, no matter what.
Octavia precisely saw through Jin's feelings.

"You must want to save your friend. But if your family intervenes, he will surely die. If you had handed him over to us, you could have saved your friend. With an 80% probability, as your head of the family said."
"Do you think Lun Kandel will intervene to save me, Octavia Ziepil?"
"Absolutely. You've reached such a position in Lun Kandel now."
"I appreciate the compliment, but that won't happen."
"You must be saying that because you have a hidden power. I look forward to it, show me everything."
"And rather, it would be better for you if my family doesn't intervene, if you want to live."
Octavia smiled.
She was not afraid of Rosa's direct intervention.
"Speaking of which, I don't see your guardian dragon. I have a debt to pay back to him too..."
Suddenly, Octavia cut off her words.
Two black stars suddenly rose into the sky, where Kelliac's magic and Ron's sword were clashing madly.
She had seen the same scene two years ago.
[Little one!]
Murakan.
[Jin.]
And Misha.
The two guardian dragons for the Contractor of the Soldrets were descending towards Jin. Once again, Octavia had to feel the terrible discomfort pressing on her brain.
